en.title: Microsoft AI Customer Cases: 1000+ Enterprise Transformation Stories
en.why: Filterable by product, industry and outcome, and each case carries the pain it started from and what actually changed. The fastest way to find something close enough to your own work to argue with.

zh.title: Microsoft AI 客户案例全景：1000+ 企业转型故事
zh.why: 可按产品、行业、业务成果筛选，每个案例都写了它从什么痛点出发、最后变了什么。想找一个接近你们自己情况、能拿来对照的例子，这里最快。

en.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Positioning, Capabilities, Adoption & Pricing
en.why: If you read one article before the twelve questions, read this one. It is what Copilot Studio actually is, what it can and cannot do, and what it costs.

zh.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio：定位、能力、落地路径与费用
zh.why: 回答十二道题之前只读一篇的话，就读这篇。Copilot Studio 到底是什么、能做什么不能做什么、以及要花多少钱。

en.title: Agentic AI Adoption Practice: Planning Enterprise Rollout with a Maturity Model
en.why: The maturity model the twelve questions are measuring you against, written out in full.

zh.title: Agentic AI 导入实践：用成熟度模型规划企业落地
zh.why: 十二道题在拿什么尺子量你——这篇把那把尺子完整写了出来。

en.title: Copilot Studio vs Agents SDK: Positioning, Relationship & Scenario Selection
en.why: Answers the question every technical person in the room asks first: why not just write the code ourselves?

zh.title: Copilot Studio 与 Agents SDK：产品定位、协作关系与场景选型
zh.why: 回答会议室里技术同事一定会先问的那句：为什么不干脆自己写代码？

en.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Constraints & Engineering Boundaries
en.why: The limits you will hit — quotas, topic and instruction ceilings, knowledge-source sync. Cheaper to read now than to discover in week six.

zh.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio 约束条件与工程边界
zh.why: 你迟早会撞上的那些墙：配额、Topics 与 Instructions 的硬上限、知识源同步限制。现在读，比第六周才发现便宜得多。

en.title: Copilot Studio Memory Management: Variable Scopes, Conversation History & Knowledge Retrieval
en.why: Why your agent forgets things, and which of the four memory layers to reach for.

zh.title: Copilot Studio 记忆管理机制：变量作用域、对话历史与知识检索
zh.why: 你的 agent 为什么会忘事，以及四层记忆机制该用哪一层。

en.title: Copilot Studio CUA: GUI Automation Capability, Limits & Cost
en.why: For the systems with no API. Read the success-rate and cost sections before you promise anyone this.

zh.title: Copilot Studio CUA：让 Agent 操作网页与桌面应用的能力、边界与成本
zh.why: 给那些没有 API 的老系统用的。在向任何人承诺之前，先看成功率和成本那两节。

en.title: Power Platform Governance Quickstart: Licensing to Operations
en.why: Licensing, capacity, environments and permissions in one place — the background to every item on your IT checklist.

zh.title: Power Platform 治理速览：从许可到运维落地
zh.why: 许可、容量、环境、权限一次讲清——你那份 IT 清单上每一条的背景都在这里。

en.title: Power Platform Pricing System & Interactive Estimator
en.why: Includes a working estimator. Use it to put a number on the licence line before you take the checklist to procurement.

zh.title: Power Platform 报价体系与互动估算器：从需求到产品配置
zh.why: 里面有个能用的估算器。把清单交给采购之前，先用它把许可那一行的数字算出来。

en.title: Dataverse Security Role Guide: Concepts, Predefined Roles & Best Practices
en.why: What to hand your identity team when the checklist asks who may build, and who may publish.

zh.title: Dataverse Security Role 完全指南：概念、预定义角色与最佳实践
zh.why: 当清单问到「谁能建、谁能发布」时，这就是你要转给身份管理团队的那一篇。
